instruction_following.description: Did the report answer the requested task, respect scope, and satisfy explicit format constraints?

comprehensiveness.description: Did the report cover the major relevant subtopics, counterarguments, sources, and limitations?

insight.description: Did the report synthesize evidence into non-obvious, useful conclusions rather than only summarizing sources?

writing_objectivity.description: Was the writing clear, calibrated, source-bounded, and free of unsupported overclaiming?

fact_mini.description: Evaluate sampled factual cited claims against linked evidence or fetched source text when network mode is explicitly enabled.
